consent.bakebot: Uhlaziyo lwee-odolo luvela ku-BakeBot, umncedisi ozenzekelayo we-KD Pops. UKaydee ufunda aze aqinisekise yonke i-odolo ngokwakhe.
consent.popia: Ukuze silungiselele i-odolo yakho sigcina igama lakho, inombolo yeselfowuni nolwimi. NguKaydee nomncedisi wakhe kuphela abanokuzibona. Zigcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo nguSupabase e-EU, azisetyenziselwa ntengiso, kwaye zicinywa kwiintsuku ezingama-90 emva kwe-odolo yakho yokugqibela.
consent.agree: Ndiyavuma ukuba i-KD Pops isebenzise iinkcukacha zam kwi-odolo yam
consent.guardian: Umzali okanye umgcini wam uthi ndingaodola
consent.declined: Akukho ngxaki. Akukho nto igciniweyo. Usenako ukuodola ngokuthumela uKaydee umyalezo we-WhatsApp.
consent.guardianNeeded: Nceda ubuze umzali okanye umgcini kuqala. Akukho nto igciniweyo. Ungaodola nangoKaydee kwi-WhatsApp.
